# H is a second copy of the same block: rows h_start .. h_start+nH-1 of input_google_R9_11_617.txt (0-based, restricted to those columns)

# the block G = H is the Taylor graph of Paley(281): taylor_map_G564.txt lists 'i f(i)' with i a vertex of Taylor(Paley(281)) as built in build.py and f(i) the vertex of the Google block
